evidence.notes: The AccessType enum resolves its CREATABLE value at runtime.
The Quiddity enum resolves its AURA value at runtime.

source.content: System.AccessType access = System.AccessType.valueOf('CREATABLE'); System.assertEquals('CREATABLE', access.name()); System.Quiddity quiddity = System.Quiddity.valueOf('AURA'); System.assertEquals('AURA', quiddity.name());
